scope: AR-02 pre-G3 formula-to-JAGS-data interface repair only; independent QA of four wrapper calls and six design matrices at an intercepted sampling boundary

findings.finding: The four repaired formula pairs follow formula1=w/Xw and formula2=a/Xa; no other runner lines differ from both preserved before-copies.
findings.evidence: Before/after SHA-256 match the frozen manifest and two prior snapshot sets; diff -u has exactly 6/6 and 2/2 changed lines, all formula1/formula2; git diff --check exit 0.

findings.finding: The actual extracted wrapper call expressions reached the replaced runjags::run.jags export, with responses, N, n, all six matrices and their dimensions matching direct expectations; reversed-response controls failed as intended.
findings.evidence: Full rerun log; exit 0; eight sampler-stub captures, zero compiler-guard entries, namespace restoration. Static inspection verified both guards were installed before eval and sampler_stub has no call to original run.jags.

findings.finding: An independent covariate-only mutation preserves w, a and N but changes both Xw and Xa, so response-only comparison cannot mask the covariate reversal.
findings.evidence: Independent probe exit 0; two sampler-stub captures, zero compiler entries, namespace restoration.

execution.note: First independent QA probe stopped in its own AST walker before wrapper evaluation; fixed only the QA probe to skip missing call arguments.

boundary.note: The package prints MCMC in progress before calling run.jags; the message does not indicate sampling. G0/G1/G7 integrity hold and G2 general inconclusive status are separate and were not adjudicated here.
